meta.name: outlier-post-finder
meta.description: Use when the user wants to find posts, videos, reels, shorts, tweets, or social content that overperformed versus a creator, brand, or competitor baseline. Finds outliers, explains why they worked, extracts hooks and formats, and produces a practical swipe file.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现表现超常的社交内容并提炼可复用钩子
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做社媒运营却总困惑为何某些内容突然爆火
copy.tagline_en: Find overperforming social posts and extract reusable hooks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run social media and wonder why some posts outperform the rest.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会找出某创作者或品牌近期表现远超其平时水平的社交媒体帖子，解释成功原因，提取开头钩子与内容格式，并生成一份带源链接的挪用文件报告。
howto.when: 当用户要求查找爆款帖子、分析创作者内容为何有效，或想从高表现内容中建立 swipe file 时触发。

say.text: 看看这个 TikTok 账号最近哪些视频表现异常好，为什么？
say.note: Claude 会拉取帖子并输出异常值报告。

say.text: 帮我找出这个 Instagram 博主超常发挥的帖子，并总结可复制的套路。
say.note: 会生成带钩子和格式的 swipe file。

say.text: 整理一个竞品高赞推文的 swipe file，列出钩子和格式。
say.note: 会按你的要求提取模式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude identifies social posts that significantly outperformed a creator's or brand's typical baseline, explains why they worked, extracts hooks and formats, and produces a swipe file report with source links.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to find viral posts, analyze why a creator's content is effective, or build a swipe file from high-performing social content.

say_en.text: Check which videos recently overperformed on this TikTok account and why.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch posts and output an outlier report.

say_en.text: Find this Instagram creator's unusually successful posts and summarize repeatable patterns.
say_en.note: Generates a swipe file with hooks and formats.

say_en.text: Build a swipe file of a competitor's top tweets, listing hooks and formats.
